deadline.value: No deadline appears on the fetched catalog page.

gre_general.value: The GRE is optional for this program.

gre_subject.value: The catalog does not mention a GRE Subject test.

toefl_min.value: The department page gives the old-scale TOEFL iBT 79, which predates the January 2026 change; the new-scale value is not confirmed.

ielts_min.value: The program also accepts an IELTS minimum of 6.5.
ielts_min.quote: a minimum of 6.5 on the Internation English Language Testing System will be accepted

supervisor.value: Students work with an advisor on a plan of study after admission; no pre-admission agreement is stated.

funding.value: The catalog does not describe PhD funding.

entry_route.value: Applicants enter with a bachelor's in engineering and a 3.25 GPA; the program is 47 credit hours past the bachelor's.
entry_route.quote: 47 credit hours of course work beyond their bachelor's degree

notes: Source: the 2026-27 graduate catalog Translational Bioengineering PhD section. Several specialization tracks are listed; the MD-PhD track is limited to UofL MD-PhD students.
